validity_findings.finding: Pre-freeze census/calibration artifacts cited in spec.json and prereg.md do not match the contemporaneous /tmp artifacts (design_review N1). The frozen text cites probe_live.py sha256 c100f177..., census.json sha256 b0b9e520..., calibrate4.py sha256 3e603e32..., cal4.json sha256 5fd08d99... but the files actually present have different hashes. Impact is bounded because these are explicitly declared non-interpretation-dependencies (spec.measurement_validity.activity_disclosure) and EXECUTE re-derived all floors/controls from its own data. AUDIT verified the EXECUTE run independently satisfies all prerequisites.

Frozen textual attainability certificate (prereg section 7.1, spec.decision_rule.thresholds_frozen) claims two cold sweeps ~132 s apart with identical histograms {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE:5, TRANSPORT_ERROR:1, OTHER_NONBARRIER:5, CLEAN:46} and 'no ambient class changed'. The contemporaneous census.json shows delta=38.5 s, histograms with 6 BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE and a RATE_LIMIT_429 on search.brave.com that changed to CLEAN (design_review N2). The intrinsic-persistence claim still holds (the changed endpoint is non-intrinsic; 7 intrinsic endpoints persisted in EXECUTE). This is a documentation discrepancy in the pre-freeze certificate text, not a failure of the frozen measurement itself.

Internal definition conflict for DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT denominator. spec.decision_rule.primary_decision_quantities states 'both computed on the intrinsic set only', which contradicts the frozen falsifier and prereg.md section 4 where DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT denominator is |T0 non-intrinsic| (51). EXECUTE correctly implemented the falsifier/prereg definition (FR = 0/50 = 0). The conflict is resolved in favor of the falsifier/prereg (design_review N3). No metric recomputation is affected.

Control-parameter inconsistency: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY and NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE literal_design_values specify perms_per_rep=500, replications_R=300, while spec.decision_rule.thresholds_frozen and prereg section 6 specify 10000 permutations/resamples for the main test. The pre-freeze calibration artifact used R=200, PERM=BOOT=10000. The power gate (pc_power_min=0.80 at rho=0.98) is satisfied in EXECUTE (0.823 unconditional, 0.879 conditional on n_t0_intrinsic>=3) regardless. The inconsistency is a documentation defect, not a measurement failure (design_review N4).

Single network vantage / single stdlib client / single ~2041 s session is a declared scope boundary (spec.scope_boundaries, spec.measurement_validity.representation_integrity). The director mandate question named 'source vantage points' as part of the measured axis, but the frozen design fixes one egress (design_review N6). This limits external validity/generalizability but does not affect internal validity of the frozen question. The claim ceiling correctly bounds to this pool/vantage/window.

Window censoring at delta_ref=1800 s: DENYLIST_HORIZON=1800 is right-censored by the protocol. No claim is made about persistence beyond the tested ladder. This is a declared design feature, not a defect.

Protocol self-induction cannot be fully ruled out; C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION only bounds ambient barrier prevalence on the 52 non-stress endpoints. The observed barrier prevalence on non-stress endpoints is perfectly flat across rungs (0.1346 at all rungs, slope=0, CI=[0,0]), which bounds but does not eliminate the possibility that the 5 stressed endpoints induced transients that would not occur under operational traffic patterns.

baseline_findings.finding: Primary strong null (global uniform permutation of lag barrier indicator, 10000 permutations, seed 38074818597). Observed p = 9.999e-05 (1/10001, the minimum possible with this permutation count). The null is decisively rejected. The permutation test correctly preserves both marginals.

No-denylist floor (predict non-barrier for every endpoint). Log-loss = 1.6966 nats/endpoint. DENYLIST_SKILL = 1.6966 nats/endpoint improvement over this floor, confirming the anchor intrinsic-transfer predictor has substantial predictive value.
Constant-marginal diagnostic (predict lag class from lag-period marginal frequency). Log-loss = 0.3725 nats, marginal barrier prevalence = 0.1228. Reported as diagnostic only.

Recent-memory diagnostic (predict next rung from immediately preceding rung). Accuracy = 0.9942, MI = 0.4056 nats. The high accuracy reflects the near-perfect stability of the barrier indicator across adjacent rungs. Reported as diagnostic only.

claim_ceiling: C-WEB-DYNAMICS = HYPOTHESIS (bounded to this frozen 57-endpoint pool, one network egress vantage, one ~30-minute window ladder with horizon censored at 1800 s). S1_STATIONARY is supported on this pool/window: intrinsic classes persist (INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT=true, CLASS_PERSISTENCE=1.0 for both present intrinsic classes), the intrinsic denylist remains valid through the tested horizon (DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID=true, DENYLIST_HORIZON=1800 s right-censored), and the anchor barrier indicator carries information beyond the exchangeable null (STATIONARITY_SKILL=0.320 nats, B_EXCHANGE p<0.001, clustered CI lower=0.142>0). CLASS_CONDITIONAL_TRANSIENCE=true (RATE_RECOVERY_n=1, RATE_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE_s=2) licenses a class-conditional policy. No promotion to EXPERIMENTAL or PRODUCT_CORE; the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS is bounded but not closed.
unresolved: Does endpoint access-barrier persistence generalize beyond this frozen 57-endpoint pool, this single egress vantage, and this ~30-minute window? The source-vantage axis is untested (VF5).
Is the measured horizon censored: would the intrinsic denylist remain valid at delta > 1800 s? (VF6)
ONSET (CLEAN->intrinsic) at higher request rates or longer sequences remains untested outside the fixed 8-GET stress burst.
The simultaneous role of protocol self-induction cannot be fully removed; C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION only bounds ambient barrier prevalence on the 52 non-stress endpoints (VF7).
